item.title: ODKE+: Ontology-Guided Open-Domain Knowledge Extraction with LLMs
item.description:
Review

So I finally sat down with ODKE+, Apple’s paper on how they keep their knowledge graph fresh. They read the web, pull facts out in the shape of an ontology, check them, and merge them into the graph. I didn’t stop at reading it though. I built the whole thing as an open-source package, openodke (so yes, I have skin in this game, keep that in mind), and then tested it on public data against the two libraries most people would actually reach for.
